metadata.technology: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe (with MCU + radio)
metadata.technology_specification: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe with integrated microcontroller unit (MCU) and radio communication module
metadata.technology_reasoning: This configuration represents the industry-standard form for soil moisture sensing in precision agriculture and IoT applications as of 2024, combining capacitive sensing for accurate moisture detection with embedded MCU for signal processing and integrated radio for wireless data transmission, enabling standalone wireless probe deployment.

components.reasoning: The core functional component that detects soil moisture by measuring dielectric permittivity changes, universally present and separately manufactured for accuracy and durability.
Responsible for processing sensor data and executing firmware, typically a distinct integrated circuit module, essential in all smart sensor probes.

components.component: Radio Communication Module (e.g., Sub-GHz or Bluetooth Low Energy)
components.reasoning: Enables wireless data transmission to gateways or hubs, usually a standardized module with antenna, critical for IoT applications.
Holds and interconnects sensor components, MCU, radio module, and power management circuits; typically procured as a defined assembly.

components.component: Power Supply Module (Battery or Energy Harvesting Unit)
components.reasoning: Provides power to all electronics; commonly a rechargeable lithium-ion or primary battery or sometimes energy harvesting unit, purchased or assembled as a separate component.
Protects sensor and electronics from environmental exposure, typically molded or machined as a separate physical assembly.
Critical for radio communication efficiency, often a dedicated component or integral part of the radio module but sometimes separately designed for performance optimization.
